From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novacare.com>, Andre Dupont <andre.dupont@novacare.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.inference, karthik_iyer@redwood.inference
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action takt & evaluation runlist — Post-signature onboarding

Hi Samantha / Andre,

Congrats again on signing — really excited to get Novacare onto Redwood. Attached is a lightweight mutual-action runlist (embedded plan) that combines the rollout cadence, canary window, migration steps, training slots, and an evaluation rubric for acceptance testing. The idea is a single living artifact we iterate during ops planning.

High-level asks for this week:
- Review the attached Novacare_MAP_v1.xlsx and confirm the canary week that works for your infra team. We propose Aug 14–20 for a small pilot.
- Confirm which user cohort we can seed (approx. 50–200 active sessions) for the canary.
- Share SOC 2 or privacy point-of-contact for the evidence packet (we received an initial list from procurement).

What’s in the attached runlist:
- Phase A: Staged rollout (env prep, backup plan, smoke tests)
- Phase B: Canary (traffic split, metrics thresholds, rollback triggers)
- Phase C: Migration (data sync, cutover steps, DNS and routing checklist)
- Training: Train-the-trainer & enablement sessions (two 90-min sessions + office hours)
- Evaluation plan: prompt-sample evals, latency/cost SLO gating, quality regression checks

If you prefer, we can turn the runlist into a short mutual-action timeline in HubSpot for owners and due dates.

Attachments: Novacare_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-request.pdf

Thanks — I’ll loop in Marissa and Karthik from delivery to draft the operational slots.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — brief update and proposed schedule below. I put owners in the runlist and added a simple evaluation rubric (pass/fail + numeric thresholds) — see attached implementation-cadence.pdf for a printable checklist.

Proposed rollout (high level):
- Phase A (Env prep): Aug 7–11 — infra provisioning, secrets & KMS checks, baseline perf run (baseline tokens/sec). Owner: Laura
- Phase B (Canary pilot): Aug 14–20 — 100-session cohort, 10% traffic split, golden prompt set for regressions. Owner: Karthik
- Phase C (Migration): Aug 21–24 — data sync, DNS flip staging (maintenance window Aug 24 01:00–03:00 UTC). Owner: Marissa
- Training & Enablement: Aug 22 & Aug 29 — two 90-min sessions (train-the-trainer + hands-on lab). Owner: Laura

Evaluation plan (short):
- Quality: no more than 5% semantic regression on the golden prompt set (Samantha asked for this threshold).
- Latency: P50 <= 220ms, P95 <= 550ms during canary at target concurrency.
- Errors: <0.2% 5xx error rate during pilot window.
- Cost guardrail: token spend vs baseline projection (we will flag if >20% deviation).

Rollback triggers:
- Any single metric crossing critical threshold (e.g., P95 > 1s or semantic regression >10%) -> immediate traffic rollback to baseline model
- Unresolved SOC evidence request beyond 7 business days -> pause production cutover

Attachments now: implementation-cadence.pdf (checklist), also updated Novacare_MAP_v1.xlsx in the shared draft.

Linking the HubSpot deal and the shared runlist: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/98765
